scope: Production GC10 CB_RESOLVE state decoder, original fragment factory, scalar reference and native adapted color transfers; no GPU/device or complete-renderer claim.

implementation.operation: GC10 CB_COLOR_CONTROL mode3 averages MRT0 logical samples into single-sample MRT1.
implementation.supported: Uncompressed matching RGBA8_UNORM R64KB_X views, 2/4/8 equal coverage/fragments, no mips/arrays/depth/stencil work, one direct unindexed three-vertex rectangle.
implementation.geometry: Actual guest vertex program and canonical generated TCS/TES; no fullscreen coverage assumption. Normal destination load/store preserves pixels outside the rectangle/scissor.
implementation.sourceIsolation: ReadColorTarget flushes pending GPU writes via production GuestMemory; a retained immutable tiled copy precedes destination writes, including aliasing ranges.
implementation.descriptor: Samplerless set0 sampled texture2DMSArray; unused binding above guest VS bindings; logical8 is native4 samples in two layers.
implementation.ordering: Resolve recognized before ordinary PA_SC_MODE_CNTL_0 MSAA_ENABLE rejection. Storage sample count does not force raster MSAA during fixed-function resolve.
implementation.notOptimizedYet: Snapshot/detile/retile/upload is a correctness-first path; repeated resolve resource growth and a GPU-resident fast path remain to be measured.

checks: destination padding, alias suffix and guard preservation
tests.spirv: Original GLSL variants2/4/8 and production factory binding remaps0/6 passed spirv-val --target-env vulkan1.1.

capturedState.memory: Test-owned native allocations only; no game pixels or shader contents used.

tests.nativeMemoryBoundary: Explicit macOS mapped-range adapter. Wine GuestMemory write-watch, deferred GPU hooks and GPU rasterization are outside this native fixture.
tests.scalarRounding: Integer round-by-half oracle. GPU UNORM conversion may differ by one byte at ties; this native test does not establish AMD hardware rounding equivalence.

limits: No full HLE link or production Driver execution is claimed here.
No Solitaire visual/gameplay, audio or FPS qualification.
No iPad runtime or GPU result inferred from these native checks.
The independent original GPU probe and subsequent full-renderer device test are separate evidence.

primaryReferences.supports: HwlCanDoFixedFuncResolve: matching format/offset/swizzle and hardware average rather than min/max.
